heard: A giant human skull once flew past Earth on Halloween night. On October 10, 2015, astronomers in Hawaii spotted a massive object inbound. It was moving at 78,000 miles per hour, closing the gap in three weeks. On Halloween day, it missed us by only 300,000 miles, just beyond the moon. Scientists at the Arecibo Observatory bounced radar off the surface to reveal its shape. The returning image showed two hollow eye sockets and a nose above a chin. Astronomers discovered it was a dead comet, not an asteroid. This 2,000-foot corpse reflects light-like dark asphalt. Nature spent eons stripping this comet until it looked like.
